records.explanation: Trailhead had the most installs over the whole period, with 34,706 installs summed across all of its campaigns' keywords.
records.sql:
SELECT c.app_name, SUM(kd.installs) AS total_installs
FROM reporting.keyword_daily kd
JOIN reporting.keywords k ON k.keyword_id = kd.keyword_id
JOIN reporting.ad_groups ag ON ag.ad_group_id = k.ad_group_id
JOIN reporting.campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = ag.campaign_id
GROUP BY c.app_name
ORDER BY total_installs DESC
LIMIT 1

records.explanation: Across all campaigns, Brand ad groups (excluding Non-Brand ones) spent about $0.72 per install, with spend converted to US dollars at each day's exchange rate.
records.sql:
SELECT SUM(k.spend / CASE WHEN c.currency = 'USD' THEN 1 ELSE f.units_per_usd END) / NULLIF(SUM(k.installs), 0) AS cost_per_install_usd
FROM reporting.keyword_daily k
JOIN reporting.keywords kw ON kw.keyword_id = k.keyword_id
JOIN reporting.ad_groups ag ON ag.ad_group_id = kw.ad_group_id
JOIN reporting.campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = ag.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN reporting.fx_rates f ON f.day = k.day AND f.currency = c.currency
WHERE ag.ad_group_name ILIKE '%brand%' AND ag.ad_group_name NOT ILIKE '%non%brand%'

records.explanation: The warehouse hid this figure because the group had fewer than 50 installs, so the NULL means the count was suppressed and not that nothing matched, and the exact number can't be given.
records.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.installs), 0) AS installs
FROM reporting.audience_daily a
JOIN reporting.campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE c.campaign_name = 'Ledgerly - DE - Search'
  AND a.day = DATE '2026-10-05'
  AND a.age_band = '18-24'
  AND LOWER(a.gender) IN ('f', 'female', 'woman', 'women')
